en: Colorized vintage view of a large brick railway station complex in a historic architectural style, with multiple gabled roofs and small towers. A man in an early 20th‑century suit and hat walks across a cobbled square in the foreground. At the top left, printed text reads "NIJMEGEN  Station". Faint postal cancellation marks are visible in the sky area, reinforcing the postcard appearance.
